meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: Claude 会把一个带依赖的请求拆成多个子步骤，按先后顺序分批执行：先跑没有前置条件的步骤，前置步骤都通过后，再跑等待中的后续步骤，并用证据核实完成。一次运行只推进一个阶段；某个步骤失败或跑偏时，可单独重试、发消息纠正或修改定义，不必重跑已完成部分。
howto.when: 当用户要求做 mass-ulw、一个任务依赖图(DAG)，或部分任务必须等其它任务先完成的多子任务编排时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw：先审计 docs 里的过期内容，再改写，最后验证示例。
say.note: 会被编排成审计→改写→验证的同阶段依赖链。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw：A、B 可并行，都成功后再跑 C。
say.note: A、B 先并行；C 在两者完成后启动，失败可单独重试。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw：让各模块先并行总结，全部完成后再合成报告。
say.note: 总结节点并行，汇总节点等待所有总结完成后才运行。

howto.what_en: Drives dependency-ordered subtask work in waves: independent nodes run first, dependents start after prerequisites finish. One run covers one phase; success requires verification; recover per node via retry/send/amend, keeping finished results.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw: audit docs for stale content, rewrite, then verify samples.
say_en.note: Defines one dependency chain: audit, rewrite, verify.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw: A and B can run in parallel; run C after both succeed.
say_en.note: C waits for A/B; retry alone if needed.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw: summarize per module, then write one consolidated report.
say_en.note: Summaries run in parallel; report waits for all.
